I reviewed Helix_MSA_Redlines_v2.pdf and suggest we focus the call on the following three items as a priority (we can triage the rest asynchronously):

- Section 4.2 (Data retention / audit logs): Redwood standard is 13 months for audit logs; we can offer a 24-month option for enterprise customers with a commercial uplift.
- Section 7 (Subprocessors): we’ll bring our current list and a process for notice/approval on new subprocessors.
- Section 11 (Incident notifications & remedies): we’ll present our standard SLA text and a proposed amendment window for high-severity incidents.

Operational asks for the onboarding checklist: please confirm SSO method (SAML vs OIDC) and whether Helix requires a private VPC deployment or Redwood Dedicated. That will change the sequence of evidence items in Neha’s runbook.
